caption: A sewing machine runs at speed, and its needle bar blurs up and down while the table beneath it trembles.

sa.check: A sewing machine on a table, running.
The needle bar blurs up and down.
The speed is high: the needle is a blur.
The trembling happens while the needle moves.

pc.expect: The needle bar moves straight up and down in its housing and the table trembles only while the machine runs.
pc.fail: The needle bar wanders sideways out of its housing; or the table trembles while the needle is sharp and still; or the trembling goes on after the machine has stopped.

pc.expect: While the needle blurs, the machine body and the table tremble; when the needle stops they are still.
pc.fail: The needle blurs at speed and the machine body and table stand dead still; or the needle stops and its blur remains; or the hand wheel is sharp and still while the needle blurs.

pc.expect: The machine rests on the table.
pc.fail: The machine lifts; or tilts and hangs; or rises.

pc.expect: The needle and table are rigid; the blur is motion, not bending.
pc.fail: The needle bends; or the table top ripples like water; or the machine body flexes.

pc.expect: One machine with one needle; nothing passes into the table.
pc.fail: A second needle appears; or the needle vanishes; or the machine sinks into the table; or turns into another object.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The machine's colour, the table pattern and the thread stay the same.
pc.fail: The machine changes colour; or the table pattern changes; or the thread changes colour.
